name: dxgx/blade-tailwind-extract
description: Extract Tailwind CSS classes to reduce Livewire wire transfer size

post-install-cmd: # Calculate size and remove unnecessary directories from vendor packages to save disk space

find vendor \( -name '.git' -o -name 'tests' -o -name 'test' -o -name 'demo' -o -name 'examples' -o -name '.github' \) -type d -exec du -sk {} + 2>/dev/null | awk '{sum+=$1}END{if(sum>0)printf "Removing %d KB of unnecessary files\n",sum}'; find vendor \( -name '.git' -o -name 'tests' -o -name 'test' -o -name 'demo' -o -name 'examples' -o -name '.github' \) -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find vendor -name '.DS_Store' -delete 2>/dev/null
post-update-cmd: # Calculate size and remove unnecessary directories from vendor packages to save disk space

find vendor \( -name '.git' -o -name 'tests' -o -name 'test' -o -name 'demo' -o -name 'examples' -o -name '.github' \) -type d -exec du -sk {} + 2>/dev/null | awk '{sum+=$1}END{if(sum>0)printf "Removing %d KB of unnecessary files\n",sum}'; find vendor \( -name '.git' -o -name 'tests' -o -name 'test' -o -name 'demo' -o -name 'examples' -o -name '.github' \) -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find vendor -name '.DS_Store' -delete 2>/dev/null
